planned_adapter_contract.meaning_of_future_twin: offline-importable source-neutral adapter over a canonical causal snapshot; no broker/live connection and no live-parity claim

official_spx.derivations: completed close; cumulative VWAP=sum(close*volume)/sum(volume), mean-close fallback at zero volume; range=max(close)-min(close); open=first close; OMAR=(close-open)/range else 0; momentum=current-minus-lagged close
official_spx.selection: latest available_at<=decision_time with decision_time-available_at in [0,90 seconds]; no forward fill
official_spx.source_receipt: bind exact manifest relative path/file SHA-256 plus selected parquet row-group, row-index, canonical-row SHA-256, event_time, and available_at

option_quotes.derivations: normalized mid from completed quote; canonical feature transform quantizes at $0.05
